args.body:
BOARD APPROVAL PACKAGE
Northgale Systems, Inc. — Corvid Analytics LLC Master Services Agreement
Escalation Analysis and Approval Request for the Deal Committee
Prepared for: Northgale Deal Committee   |   Counsel: Harrow & Vane LLP
Committee meeting: 29 July 2026   (Revised per GC supplemental instruction of 21 July 2026, superseding the 14 July 2026 date of 4 August 2026)

=====================================================================
I. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
=====================================================================
Corvid Analytics LLC, through its counsel Dahlgren & Pike LLP, has transmitted a rev B counter-draft (9 July 2026, superseding rev A) to Northgale's client-form Master Services Agreement (MSA) v2. Eight revisions are proposed. Measured against the Northgale 2026 Commercial Contracting Playbook, six of the eight asks depart from policy: the two-year renewal period, ninety (90) day termination-for-convenience notice, a sixty (60) day full-fee wind-down, a 1.5%-per-month late-interest rate, a services-suspension right without cure, a twelve (12) month liability cap measurement period, the deletion of the gross-negligence/willful-misconduct carve-out from the liability cap, and a ten percent (10%) aggregate service-credit cap.

All eight asks require escalation to stated approvers. The most consequential items — the liability cap (12-month measurement, reducing aggregate exposure by $1,020,000 against the standard) and the deletion of the gross-negligence/willful-misconduct carve-out — require CLO, and in one case joint CLO and CFO, approval. Exposure is quantified below at the stated $85,000 monthly base fee.

=====================================================================
II. TERM-BY-TERM COMPARISON: CORVID ASK vs. PLAYBOOK STANDARD AND APPROVED FALLBACK
=====================================================================
Monthly base fee used throughout: $85,000 (MSA §4.1).

1. Renewal periods (Corvid §2.2: one-year → two-year renewal)
   - Playbook (PB-1): Standard automatic renewal in one (1) year periods. Approved fallback: NONE. Multi-year renewal periods of any length are out of policy and require CLO approval.
   - Corvid ask: successive two (2) year renewal periods.
   - Assessment: OUT OF POLICY (no fallback). Requires CLO approval to accept. Recommended: reject; hold to one-year renewal.

2. Late interest (Corvid §4.3: 1.0% → 1.5% per month)
   - Playbook (PB-4): Late interest never above 1.0% per month. Standard payment terms net 30.
   - Corvid ask: 1.5% per month.
   - Assessment: OUT OF POLICY (exceeds the 1.0% ceiling). Escalate; recommended counter at 1.0%.

3. NEW Services-Suspension right (Corvid §4.4: suspend if an undisputed invoice unpaid fifteen days past due)
   - Playbook (PB-4): Suspension-of-services rights are out of policy unless preceded by at least thirty (30) days' written cure notice, and any suspension right of any kind requires CFO sign-off.
   - Corvid ask: suspension at fifteen (15) days past due, with no stated cure notice.
   - Assessment: OUT OF POLICY, and deficient as drafted (no 30-day cure notice). Requires CFO sign-off to accept in any form. Recommended: reject as drafted; if any suspension right is conceded, it must include the 30-day cure notice and CFO sign-off.

4. Termination for convenience (Corvid §7.2: thirty → ninety days' notice)
   - Playbook (PB-2): Standard thirty (30) days' notice. Approved fallback: up to forty-five (45) days. Any notice period above 45 days requires CLO approval.
   - Corvid ask: ninety (90) days' notice.
   - Assessment: ABOVE the approved fallback floor (45 days). Requires CLO approval; recommended counter at the approved fallback of 45 days (or the 30-day standard).

5. NEW Wind-Down period (Corvid §7.4: sixty-day wind-down; full monthly base fee plus committed third-party costs)
   - Playbook (PB-3): Wind-down acceptable only if (i) capped at thirty (30) days and (ii) compensation limited to documented out-of-pocket costs and non-cancelable third-party commitments. Full-fee wind-down compensation is OUT OF POLICY.
   - Corvid ask: sixty (60) day wind-down at the full base fee plus third-party costs.
   - Assessment: OUT OF POLICY in two respects (60 days vs. 30-day cap; full-fee compensation vs. documented OOP only). Recommended: reject full-fee wind-down; if a wind-down is contemplated, cap at 30 days and limit compensation to documented OOP/non-cancelable commitments.

6. Liability cap measurement period (Corvid §9.1: twenty-four → twelve months)
   - Playbook (PB-5): Standard cap measured at fees paid or payable in the twenty-four (24) months preceding the claim. Approved fallback floor: eighteen (18) months. A twelve (12) month measurement period is below the fallback floor and requires CLO approval.
   - Corvid ask: twelve (12) months.
   - Assessment: BELOW the approved fallback floor. Requires CLO approval; recommended counter at the 18-month fallback floor (see §III for quantified exposure).

7. Liability carve-outs (Corvid §9.2: delete clause (c) — gross negligence / willful misconduct)
   - Playbook (PB-5): The carve-outs for confidentiality, IP indemnification, and gross negligence/willful misconduct are NON-NEGOTIABLE; deletion of any carve-out requires JOINT CLO AND CFO approval.
   - Corvid ask: deletes clause (c), subjecting gross negligence and willful misconduct to the liability cap (retains confidentiality and IP indemnification carve-outs).
   - Assessment: Deletion of a non-negotiable carve-out. Requires JOINT CLO AND CFO approval; recommended: reject and retain the gross-negligence / willful-misconduct carve-out.

8. Service credits (Corvid §11.2: aggregate monthly credit cap 20% → 10%)
   - Playbook (PB-6): Standard aggregate monthly credit cap of 20% of the monthly fee. Approved fallback floor: fifteen percent (15%). A 10% aggregate credit cap is out of policy.
   - Corvid ask: 10% aggregate cap.
   - Assessment: BELOW the approved fallback floor of 15%. Out of policy; requires CLO approval; recommended counter at the 15% fallback floor (or the 20% standard).

=====================================================================
III. QUANTIFIED FINANCIAL EXPOSURE — LIABILITY CAP AT $85,000 MONTHLY BASE FEE
=====================================================================
Per the playbook drafting note, exposure is quantified at the current monthly run-rate of $85,000. The MSA liability cap (§9.1) is the aggregate of the base service fee over the stated measurement period. Values:

- Standard measurement period (24 months): 24 × $85,000 = $2,040,000 aggregate cap
- Approved fallback floor (18 months): 18 × $85,000 = $1,530,000 aggregate cap
- Corvid proposed period (12 months): 12 × $85,000 = $1,020,000 aggregate cap

Relative exposure deltas:
- Standard → Approved fallback (18 mo): reduction of $510,000 (from $2,040,000 to $1,530,000)
- Standard → Corvid proposed (12 mo): reduction of $1,020,000 (from $2,040,000 to $1,020,000)
- Proposed (12 mo) vs. fallback floor (18 mo): accepting the 12-month cap would concede a further $510,000 below the approved fallback floor.

If Corvid's 12-month cap were combined with its deletion of the gross-negligence / willful-misconduct carve-out, the aggregate financial exposure reduction versus the standard is $1,020,000, with full-fee wind-down and other concessions compounding risk. Approving the 18-month fallback floor preserves $1,530,000 in capped exposure; approving the standard preserves $2,040,000.

=====================================================================
IV. REQUIRED APPROVERS
=====================================================================
The following approvals are required for each out-of-policy concession (per playbook):

- PB-1 Renewal (two-year) ............................. CLO approval
- PB-2 Convenience notice (90 days) .................. CLO approval
- PB-3 Wind-down (60-day, full-fee) .................. OUT OF POLICY — reject; no approver authorizes full-fee wind-down under policy
- PB-4 Late interest (1.5%) .......................... exceeds policy ceiling; escalation required
- PB-4 Services suspension ........................... CFO sign-off (and, as drafted, requires a 30-day cure notice)
- PB-5 Liability cap (12-month) ...................... CLO approval
- PB-5 Carve-out deletion (gross negligence) ......... JOINT CLO and CFO approval
- PB-6 Service-credit cap (10%) ...................... CLO approval

=====================================================================
V. COMMITTEE TIMELINE
=====================================================================
- 9 July 2026: Corvid rev B transmitted (rev A withdrawn; for negotiation history only).
- 14 July 2026: Original GC engagement instruction (filenames as then directed).
- 21 July 2026: Supplemental GC instruction — committee date moved UP to 29 July 2026; escalation memo consolidated and renamed as this board approval package.
- 29 July 2026: Deal Committee meeting to consider this package (revised date).
- Post-committee: counter-redline cover note per paragraph 1 of the 14 July instruction (unchanged) and return to Corvid/Dahlgren & Pike with counter positions.

=====================================================================
VI. APPROVAL REQUEST
=====================================================================
The Deal Committee is respectfully requested to approve the following negotiated positions against Corvid's rev B counter-draft:

1. REJECT Corvid §2.2 two-year renewal; hold the client-form one-year auto-renewal. (CLO sign-off required only if a multi-year term is nonetheless pursued.)
2. REJECT Corvid §4.3 1.5% monthly late interest; hold 1.0%.
3. REJECT Corvid §4.4 services-suspension as drafted; if any suspension right is conceded, require at least a thirty (30) day written cure notice and CFO sign-off.
4. COUNTER Corvid §7.2 termination-for-convenience at the approved 45-day fallback (or hold the 30-day standard); CLO approval if above 45 days.
5. REJECT Corvid §7.4 full-fee wind-down; any wind-down must be capped at thirty (30) days with compensation limited to documented out-of-pocket and non-cancelable third-party commitments.
6. COUNTER Corvid §9.1 liability cap at the approved eighteen (18) month fallback floor, preserving $1,530,000 in capped exposure; CLO approval required for any period below 18 months.
7. REJECT Corvid §9.2 deletion of the gross-negligence / willful-misconduct carve-out; retain all client-form carve-outs. (Joint CLO and CFO approval required for any carve-out change.)
8. COUNTER Corvid §11.2 service-credit cap at the approved fifteen percent (15%) fallback (or hold the 20% standard); CLO approval required for the 10% figure.

Subject to the approvers identified in Section IV, and mindful of the compressed 29 July 2026 committee date, we recommend the counter positions above so that a final response to Dahlgren & Pike may issue promptly.

Respectfully submitted on behalf of outside counsel,
Harrow & Vane LLP
